title: Chapter 289: The Sense Of Superiority Of The Proud Son Of Heaven
content:
Chapter 289: The Sense Of Superiority Of The Proud Son Of Heaven

Emperor Yuan six years, September, end.

The time has entered the late autumn unknowingly, and the earth is about to usher in a winter. The cold wind has gradually blown all the countries, bringing a little chill to the original heat.

However, after this bumper harvest, the grain storage is full, and the people have already begun to prepare for the winter and enjoy this rare and peaceful season.

On the land of Qi State in the east of the Central Plains, a country that has stood on the coast of the East China Sea for hundreds of years, its homeland and people have been brutally destroyed and killed.

The war has been going on for half a year now.

Qi State has also changed from being the richest and most populous country in the past to a state of ghosts and monsters, weeds and wild animals everywhere, and local bones scattered on the road, but no one restrains them.

Now the entire country of Qi has been completely turned into a battlefield. Whether it is the battlefield where the frontline is fiercely fought, or the rear where the turmoil has gradually subsided and the rear has gradually calmed down, there are murderous opportunities everywhere.

In this land, all the coalition soldiers have released the beasts in their hearts, and they have been completely reduced to a demon who only knows destruction and killing.

They wantonly killed people who did not belong to their own camp, no matter if they were beasts who had lost their minds on the front line and had already lost their minds.

Still in the rear, although there is no war and enjoys peace, there are still defenders who go into the mountains and forests and hunt the people of Qi.

They have already disregarded life, and even took pleasure in killing.

Therefore, anyone who appears in front of their eyes, if they cannot prove that they belong to this party, they will definitely be killed by them without hesitation, and even before they die, they will carry out some interesting activities for them. For greater enjoyment.

Also because of this, the rangers who traveled all over the world, and the scholars who traveled to various countries to study, all of them changed color after hearing the name of Qi.

This is because before, some warriors who boasted of military strength, or scholars who boasted of their status, heard that the war broke out, and wanted to rush to the front line to witness an event that would determine the fate of the world.

By the way, let's see if I can climb to a high position and become the retainer of a certain important person in the coalition army. From then on, I will ascend to the sky one step at a time, and become that small group of people who stand in high positions, guide the country, and affect the fate of the world.

Therefore, when the war just broke out, not only did they not feel sad, they felt sorry for the people who died because of it, and felt for the hard-won peace that had not been enjoyed for a long time.

On the contrary, he was extremely excited and delighted.

Like flies smelling fishy smell, they jumped on it recklessly, following in the footsteps of the coalition forces or the Qi State, they kept flying around, ready to take a share of the pie at any time.

No wonder they are like this. In fact, in the previous battle between the Qin State and the coalition forces, the coalition forces used a large number of low-level people, and promoted countless talents with talents and real talents.

Nowadays, many of these promoted people have become county magistrates or guards in one place, and even entered the thatched cottages of various countries, becoming celebrities in front of the monarch.

In the resplendent and resplendent palace hall, Fang Jiong pointed out the political affairs of a country, and even talked about the world's major affairs. Although the world is big, but he has a little bit of demeanor in my chest, he attracted countless people who aimed at them.

Then, here comes these bottom people who yearn to go further.

At the beginning, both the coalition forces and Qi State welcomed their arrival.

After all, talent, who doesn't like it in this exciting Warring States period?

And the best place to train a talent and show his true talents is on this kind of battlefield.

Therefore, both sides have attracted many people who came to seek refuge and gave them a chance to make their mark.

Then, both sides were disappointed to find that although these people had a little talent and learning, they were not many, and if they were transferred to the army, they were only about a hundred generals.

For countries, this level of talent is not lacking but more than enough.

In the barracks, countless talented people of this level are waiting to be promoted, waiting to take over a higher official position.

These old people in the barracks have enough qualifications, enough experience, and enough numbers. Just ask, how could they abandon these more trustworthy people and use these ordinary people who have just joined but have little ambition and talent!

What's more, there are continuous wars ahead, and the number of troops has dropped sharply, but the number of officers has not dropped much. After all, these officers themselves have a certain degree of force, unlike ordinary soldiers, and are protected by soldiers under their command. The possibility of sacrifice on the battlefield is far lower than that of ordinary soldiers.

However, the soldiers lost too much, but the officers lost very little, which made the few official positions even more scarce.

When there are many monks and few meat, there are countless people staring at every position. How can there be any spare resources to distribute to outsiders?

Except for those outsiders who really have some earth-shattering talents, or rampant military power (reaching the first-class level), they will be valued by those in power in the coalition forces, promoted exceptionally, and awarded high positions.

Other second- and third-rate talents, unless these people can accept their status as ten-man generals and start as low-level soldiers, otherwise they will all be swept out and abandoned in their shoes.

Anyway, there is something for this kind of talent coalition, and there are many of them.

Then, conflicts naturally erupted.

These people who want to seek an official position, so as to make a fortune. In the original villages, towns and cities, they were all well-known and had a certain prestige.

They think they are superior and have a superior status. After coming to the coalition army, they should be received by the big figures from all over the world immediately, and then they will be shocked as heavenly beings.

Well, these are all yy in their hearts.

What they really want is a decent official position, at least to reach the status of a thousand generals and a county lord, so that they are worthy of their talents and identities.

But the reality suddenly hit their ideals, knocked their dignity to nothing, threw them on the ground wantonly and trampled on them.

Being treated so contemptuously today, how can I not arouse the anger of these heaven's favorites, and feel that I have been insulted and belittled.

The man was angry, blood spattered three feet.

Many literati and warriors gathered around the barracks to make trouble, blocking the gate of the barracks, clamoring to see those in power.

In the beginning, those in power sent some people to persuade them for their reputation, hoping that they would obey the order and leave.

However, this kind of behavior was considered weak by those literati and warriors, and when they gave in, they became even more reckless and noisy.

By doing this, I hope that such a noisy movement can really attract the attention of those big shots, and then give them a little bone so that they can make up for it.

However, after all, they underestimated the superiors of the current alliance, and even more underestimated the commander of the alliance.

Now the commander of the coalition forces, Zhong Yu, who is that?

That is the current leader of the coalition forces, His Majesty the supreme emperor of the imperial country, who controls the lives of tens of thousands of people, who makes the world dangerous when he is angry, and the world is safe when he is happy.

The last one for today. It's finally the fifth watch, it's not easy!

It’s been a long time since I had a 4D explosion, and now I’m really uncomfortable with the sudden explosion. The speed can’t catch up with before, but the more I write, the better I feel, and I can’t even imagine it myself.

It seems to have returned to the passionate years of writing just a few months ago.
